abstract_sentences.text: We present SWINGARENA, an adversarial evaluation framework for Large Language Models (LLMs) that approximates real-world software development workflows.
abstract_sentences.handoff: Names the framework and its target workflow.

evidence.anchor: We present SWINGARENA, an adversarial evaluation framework

abstract_sentences.text: Unlike traditional static benchmarks, SWINGARENA models the collaborative process of software iteration by pairing LLMs as submitters, who generate patches, and reviewers, who create test cases and verify the patches through continuous integration (CI) pipelines.
abstract_sentences.handoff: Turns the gap into a two-role CI mechanism.

evidence.anchor: pairing LLMs as submitters ... and reviewers

abstract_sentences.text: To support these interactive evaluations, we introduce a retrieval-augmented code generation (RACG) module that handles long-context challenges by providing relevant code snippets from large codebases across multiple programming languages (C++, Python, Rust, and Go).
abstract_sentences.handoff: Adds the context-selection layer needed by the arena.

evidence.anchor: we introduce a retrieval-augmented code generation (RACG) module

abstract_sentences.text: Our adversarial evaluation can surface limitations that are often overlooked by traditional evaluation settings.
abstract_sentences.handoff: Claims diagnostic value without naming a failure class.

evidence.anchor: can surface limitations that are often overlooked

abstract_sentences.text: Our experiments, using over 400 high-quality real-world GitHub issues selected from a pool of 2,300 issues, indicate differing behavioral tendencies across models in patch generation versus validation.
abstract_sentences.handoff: Previews data scale and behavioral asymmetry.

evidence.anchor: over 400 high-quality real-world GitHub issues

abstract_sentences.text: SWINGARENA offers a scalable and extensible approach to evaluating LLMs in CI-driven software development settings.
abstract_sentences.handoff: Places the broadest capability claim in the closing sentence.

evidence.anchor: offers a scalable and extensible approach

introduction_moves.question_left: What does current code evaluation cover?
introduction_moves.answer: HumanEval/MBPP cover short snippets and SWE-Bench adds realism but remains static or partially simulated.
introduction_moves.next_hook: Move from benchmark abstraction to a real PR/CI loop.

evidence.anchor: Existing suites including HumanEval and MBPP focus on concise snippets

introduction_moves.question_left: What does a professional development workflow require?
introduction_moves.answer: A PR invokes GitHub Actions, tests, style, linters, compatibility checks and iterative reviewer dialogue.
introduction_moves.next_hook: Ask whether a unit-test threshold is enough.

evidence.anchor: a CI pipeline ... runs unit tests, enforces style guides

introduction_moves.answer: They ask whether code passes a unit test rather than whether it is valid, compliant and CI/review ready.
introduction_moves.next_hook: Name the mechanisms omitted by static evaluation.

evidence.anchor: Can the model submit code that is valid, compliant

introduction_moves.question_left: Which blind spots must a new arena expose?
introduction_moves.answer: Dynamic/adversarial scrutiny, collaboration and role switching, and comprehensive quality gates.

evidence.anchor: three critical blind spots

introduction_moves.question_left: How can different context windows be compared fairly?
introduction_moves.answer: RACG supplies standardized context access to isolate retrieval artifacts from the adversarial protocol.
introduction_moves.next_hook: Introduce SWINGARENA and list its contributions.

evidence.anchor: provides standardized context access

introduction_moves.question_left: What concrete artifact covers the identified gaps?
introduction_moves.answer: A dual-role CI protocol, four-language RACG baseline, and CI-grounded 2,300/400/100 data package.
introduction_moves.next_hook: Show whether models behave differently under the protocol.

evidence.anchor: Our contributions are

introduction_moves.question_left: Does the arena reveal model-specific behavior?
introduction_moves.answer: Some models are aggressive patch generators while others prioritize correctness and CI stability.
introduction_moves.next_hook: State which evaluation dimensions are measured.

evidence.anchor: some models excel at aggressive patch generation

introduction_moves.question_left: What does the protocol measure beyond static tests?
introduction_moves.answer: End-to-end success, stability, reviewer effects and RACG contribution under context limits.
introduction_moves.next_hook: The next section positions the work against prior benchmarks and RAG.

evidence.anchor: quantify stability, reviewer effects, and RACG’s contribution

equation_counts.theory_role: No formal theory is present. The equations define evaluation diagnostics; RACG determinism is stated as an implementation property.

experimental_design.name: Predeclared hypotheses
experimental_design.description: No numbered research questions or hypotheses are listed. Questions about arena behavior, RACG, language, reviewer effects and retries are inferred from subsection order.

evidence.anchor: We evaluate our method against several strong models

experimental_design.name: Task source and construction
experimental_design.description: GitHub API mining produces linked issue–PR pairs with patch, tests, base commit SHA, timestamp and CI metadata; popularity/star count is used as a quality proxy.

evidence.anchor: via the GitHub API, prioritizing those with high popularity including star count

experimental_design.name: Dataset split
experimental_design.description: 2,300 issue–solution pairs cover Rust, Python, Go and C++; 400 filtered samples are used for evaluation, 100 per language, with a 100-sample ablation split and remaining data reserved for future training.

evidence.anchor: 400 high-quality samples ... 100 per language

experimental_design.name: CI and expert filtering
experimental_design.description: Instances must pass all available CI checks; verified coverage is prioritized; Grok-3-beta rates clarity/difficulty and human experts review the rationales.

evidence.anchor: human experts finally reviewed and calibrated LLM-generated assessments

experimental_design.name: Models and baselines
experimental_design.description: Primary models are GPT-4o, Claude-3.5, Gemini-2.0 and DeepSeek-V3. Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct is used for ablation/Best@k; Appendix A adds Seed-8B, Qwen2.5-14B and DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite.

evidence.anchor: GPT-4o ... Claude-3.5 ... Gemini-2.0 ... DeepSeek-V3

experimental_design.name: Role and round schedule
experimental_design.description: Each battle has 10 rounds, with each agent executing 5 rounds in each role; the text also says models reverse roles and repeat.

evidence.anchor: a total of 10 rounds for each battle

experimental_design.name: Metrics and decision quantities
experimental_design.description: Best@k, submitter CI pass rate (SPR), reviewer CI pass rate (RPR) and adversarial Win Rate are defined. Win Rate is explicitly caveated because weak reviewer tests can increase it.

evidence.anchor: higher values may also indicate weaker reviewer tests

experimental_design.name: Retrieval and generation configuration
experimental_design.description: RACG uses at most 5 retrieved files and 16 chunks/query, with up to 3 retrieval retries. Primary decoding uses temperature 0; Best@k sampling uses temperature 0.25.

evidence.anchor: limit the number of retrieved files to 5 ... maximum of 16 code chunks

experimental_design.name: Fairness harmonization
experimental_design.description: Proprietary models share a maximum prompt-plus-generation budget B, rate limits and decoding parameters; API versions, dates, failures and retries are logged.

evidence.anchor: harmonize the maximum prompt-plus-generation token budget

experimental_design.name: Execution environment
experimental_design.description: Repository-native GitHub Actions/Travis CI are run locally in isolated Docker containers; act, pinned images and repository configuration files support reproducibility.

evidence.anchor: All evaluations run inside isolated Docker containers

experimental_design.name: Randomness control
experimental_design.description: Retrieval and sampling seeds are fixed; Appendix C reports variance over three seeds for the controlled temperature-0.25 study.

evidence.anchor: fixed random seeds for retrieval and any sampling components

experimental_design.name: Leakage and overlap control
experimental_design.description: The paper separates evaluation and future-training pools but does not report repository overlap, temporal holdout, benchmark contamination or issue deduplication checks.

evidence.anchor: remaining data are reserved for future community-driven training

experimental_design.name: Failure and rejection rules
experimental_design.description: Patch CI failure incurs -1; reviewer tests must pass on the golden patch, avoid production changes and nondeterminism, and pass style/lint gates. Integration outcome transfers a point.

evidence.anchor: Any violation results in automatic test rejection and forfeiture

experimental_design.name: Reproduction artifacts
experimental_design.description: The paper states that anonymized prompts, JSON schemas, scripts and pinned images are provided, while exact repository IDs, API versions and hardware are absent from the PDF.

evidence.anchor: prompts, JSON schemas, scripts, pinned images

final_judgment.single_storyline: 以真实 GitHub issue/PR 为任务，把固定测试 benchmark 改写为 submitter 生成 patch、reviewer 生成对抗 test、双方在 CI 中轮换计分的 arena；RACG 是把多文件多语言 code context 送入循环的配套层（p.2、p.4–7）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留三类 blind spots、battle 评分和 golden patch、Docker/CI gates、RACG 四组件、5 files/16 chunks、temperature/round 设置、Best@k/SPR/RPR/Win Rate 定义及 Table 1–3 的主方向（p.2、p.5–9）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix p.14–29 放置 open-source 表、数据分布、失败/稳定性、annotator、限制、impact、prompt、JSON 和 CI 示例；这保持了主文紧凑，却把 failure denominator、output contract、硬件/API 和检索细节移出正文。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 2 的双角色流程图配合文字评分规则；Table 3 将 RACG on/off 与 retrieval baseline 并列；RPR/SPR/Win Rate 并列且 metric 定义主动提示弱 reviewer test 的反向解释（p.5、p.7、p.9）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 结果主要是 descriptive point estimates，没有 human/static matched comparator、完整分母或 uncertainty；protocol 的文字、Algorithm 和 JSON contract 不完全一致，Table 5/6、Appendix 5 与 Figure 5 增加核对成本（p.7–9、p.14–19、p.21–29）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 交互式 benchmark 应把每个角色的输入、输出、golden/reference、reject gate、计分转移和 reverse-role 聚合写进同一可执行矩阵，并让每个分支对应结果表；扩展分布可放 appendix，决定性分母、失败判定和不确定性应留在正文。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适合 CI、agent battle 或昂贵 evaluator loop；缺少 golden patch、可运行 CI 或可校验 reviewer test 时，Win Rate/role-switch evidence 不能替代真实软件质量、人类评审或外部效度验证。

layout_observations: Main and references pages are two-column; integrated appendix is one-column.
Figure 1 and Figure 2 are cross-column workflow diagrams.
Table 1 is a wide matchup table; Table 2/3 and Figure 3 occupy column floats.
Prompt boxes and JSON/CI examples use wide single-column space from p.21 onward.
document_boundary_analysis.section_mapping_note: The semantic theory module is empty because equations are metric definitions, not formal theoretical results. Reproducibility and LLM-use statements are mapped to other; Appendix F is mapped to limitations plus appendix.

statistics_analysis.aggregation_unit: SPR/RPR average task-level check fractions; Best@k task-level at-least-one-success; Win Rate described over cumulative battle rounds.
statistics_analysis.uncertainty: No intervals, hypothesis tests, bootstrap or Bayesian analysis in main tables; Appendix C only reports median standard deviation over three seeds for a controlled sampling study.
statistics_analysis.effect_and_mechanism_boundary: Numerical gaps and correlations are descriptive; no paired task effect, causal mediation or reviewer calibration identifies why model rankings differ.
statistics_analysis.caption_self_sufficiency: Table 1–3 captions identify the broad objects; Figure 3 lacks n/seed details and Table 5/6 duplication undermines navigation.

lexical_analysis.scope: Main pages 1–10; references, footnotes, captions, table values and obvious formula fragments excluded; terms normalized for stylized SWINGARENA and case.
lexical_analysis.rhetorical_balance: Manual sentence-level reading suggests roughly a 2:1 strong-assertion to weak/qualified-assertion tendency; strong terms cluster around framework quality/scalability, while qualifiers cluster around model explanations and future retrieval.
lexical_analysis.tokenization_risk: PDF extraction splits stylized SWINGARENA, GPT-4o, Top-k and Best@k; lexical counts are therefore approximate and contextually normalized.

writing_logic.main_sequence: Problem of snippet/static evaluation → concrete PR/CI loop → three blind spots → RACG context standardization → arena/data contributions → behavior tables → ablation and failure appendix.
writing_logic.closure_quality: The central framework direction is closed by method plus Tables 1–3, but broad realism, scalability and reviewer-effect claims remain partial because controls, denominators and uncertainty are absent.
writing_logic.reader_cost: Readers must reconcile repeated Battle Protocol text, cumulative scoring, role reversal, table numbering, Appendix 5 typo, Figure 5 labels and JSON/code-only output contracts.
